goal: Ship a URL shortener as three independent units that agree on one wire format without talking to each other.

in: an integration test that exercises all three

decisions.subject: short code field in payloads
decisions.rationale: three units serialise this field and a disagreement here is invisible until integration

decisions.subject: link creation endpoint
decisions.rationale: 201 is correct for resource creation and the client branches on it

decisions.subject: link resolution endpoint
decisions.rationale: resolution is a read, not a redirect, so the client can decide what to do with the target

decisions.subject: link status values
decisions.rationale: the store writes it, the api serialises it and the client renders it

units.goal: An in-memory link store: create a record with a generated code, look one up, and expose its status.
units.notes: Pure module, no HTTP. Export createStore() returning { create, get, all }.

units.goal: An HTTP server over the store implementing the two decided endpoints, using node:http only.
units.notes: Export createServer(store). Import the store from ../src/store.js and assume it exists with createStore(); do not write it.

units.goal: A browser-side client module that calls the two decided endpoints and surfaces errors to the caller.
units.notes: Export createClient(baseUrl, fetchImpl). Inject fetch so it is testable without a network.

units.goal: Boot the real server over the real store and drive it with the real client: create a link, resolve it, and miss on an unknown code.

acceptance.statement: the store creates and resolves records
the api serves both decided endpoints
the client calls both endpoints and reports errors
all three units work together over real HTTP

openSubjects.subject: error response body shape
openSubjects.note: the server serialises it and the client parses it; settle it once

openSubjects.subject: long url field in payloads
openSubjects.note: the contract names the short code but not the destination

openSubjects.subject: store create() argument shape
openSubjects.note: an in-process interface two units share; the wire format does not cover it
